gloss: Do not forget your original intention; stay true to your goals.
teaser: Let’s explore the importance of staying true to your roots.
script:
Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Let’s explore the importance of staying true to your roots.[break 1s] The phrase is: 不忘初心, bù wàng chū xīn.[break 0.5s] 不 (bù) means 'not'[break 0.5s] 忘 (wàng) means 'forget'[break 0.5s] 初 (chū) means 'original'[break 0.5s] 心 (xīn) means 'intention' or 'heart'[break 0.5s] Full idiom again: 不忘初心 literally means 'not forget original intention' and figuratively means to stay true to one’s goals and ideals.[break 1s] Here’s the story behind it:[break 1.5s] This idiom originated from a speech by a Chinese leader, where he emphasized the importance of remembering one’s original aspirations, especially when facing challenges. It serves as a reminder to keep your initial goals in mind, no matter how difficult the journey may become. Many people have adopted this phrase as a way to inspire themselves and others to persevere.[break 1.5s] Example 1: 我们应该不忘初心，继续努力。  
We should not forget our original intention and continue to work hard.[break 1s] Example 2: 在成功后，他仍然不忘初心。  
After achieving success, he still stayed true to his original intention.[break 1s] Example 3: 教师的使命是帮助学生不忘初心。  
The mission of teachers is to help students stay true to their original intentions.[break 1s] 不忘初心 means to stay true to your goals. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom.[break 1s]
